Monsters are supposed to be locked up here but...\nThe magic seal was removed and the gate is open...
Go anyway
Not now
The gate is sealed by magic...\nLooks like you can't pass here...
Excuse me, it's not safe here.
...Right. El Scaro is beyond the wall. It's a\ntown of Resistle, and we're actually at the back\nof the town. But you can't enter there.
Whaaat?! Why? We're at the back of the town,\nshouldn't there be a back door?
Um, recently, we started farming monsters for\nmagic research use near the back gate but...
Weird monsters began to appear around here\nand we were forced to close the gate...
Eww, what the...
And, there's a facility for magic research in\nEl Scaro, so [ffff64]you can't enter the town without\npermission[ffffff]. Didn't you know that?
What?! Really?
What?! Really? Um, ha ha... Sorry, our caravan\nhardly goes to the towns of Resistle group.
Grandma Ryano said Resistle g... No, Resistle\npeople never trade with us, so it's no use\nstopping by there so...
Then, we've went on a fool's errand!\nWe can't enter the town then we can't go where\nthey create holy gems...
Are you looking for holy gems?\nThey are created in [ffff64]another place[ffffff],\nnot in El Scaro.
Is that true?!
Yes, but I don't really know where it is...
Oh, come on!
I'm so sorry... But I heard the people of other\nfactions are allowed to enter there. Why don't\nyou search for the place?
Hmm... So, we are right back where we started...
I'm sorry I couldn't help you...\nThen please accept this as a token of my apology.
This is a bouquet of  [ffff64]Star Hunter Flowers[ffffff]\nblooming around here.
You got a bouquet of Star Hunter Flowers...
Hey, do you remember what the Diel girl\nShreya said? She said the monster in Fiery Volcano\nhates Star Hunter Flowers, didn't she?
Why don't we use it and get the rare gems?\nI don't wanna waste our time and effort. Let's go.
Hi. ...What's wrong with you?
Tecaca...?\nOh, the Cule merchant?
I saw him go that way...\nYes. He said he was running an errand for a\nreputed wizard. He was in a big hurry...
Hey, we should ask her to take care of Tecaca,\nshouldn't we?
Hi. What happened?\nOh my...\nSo, Tecaca got seriously injured?
...Okay. I'll take care of him.\nPlease go on the errand for him.
